title: NFTokenCancelOffer
key_points: The NFTokenCancelOffer transaction type allows an NFT holder to cancel a previously issued offer.
It requires the sender's account to have sufficient XRP and the correct NFSellerFlag set to use this functionality.
When an offer is canceled, any associated payments are also canceled and returned to their original states.
limitations: The documentation provides high-level information but does not cover all possible edge cases or implementation details.
asserts: The NFTokenCancelOffer transaction enables NFT holders to cancel previously issued offers, effectively undoing the associated payments.
scope: Describes how the NFTokenCancelOffer transaction allows cancellation of NFT offer transactions and the consequences on linked payments.
